correctness.rationale: For any bounded complete trajectory, variation of constants backwards in \(\dot v=y^2-v\) gives \(v(t)=\int_{-\infty}^{t}e^{-(t-s)}y(s)^2\,ds\ge0\). If it vanished, then \(y=0\) on a backward half-line; bounded backward solutions of \(\dot z=-dz\) with \(d>0\) force \(z=0\) there, and then \(\dot y=k\ne0\), a contradiction. Thus every compact invariant set lies a positive distance inside \(v>0\). The generator identities for \(u,v,v^2/2,y^2/2,z^2/2\) give \(\langle y\rangle=0\), \(\langle v\rangle=\langle y^2\rangle\), \(\langle v^2\rangle=\langle vy^2\rangle\), and \(d\langle z^2\rangle=c\langle y^2\tanh v\rangle\). Strict positivity and \(0<\tanh v<v\) on the compact support give the strict transfer chain.
risks: The statement is for compact invariant sets/measures and the continuous-time ODE; transient or discretized dynamics are outside scope.
